name: vibe-studio
description: Vibe Studio skill pack for planning a new app or web product: idea, benchmark research, brand voice, design brand fitting, user flows, and build specs — written as PRODUCT.md, benchmark.md, VOICE.md, DESIGN.md, FLOWS.md, SPEC.md with an HTML report for each, and decisions logged in DECISIONS.md.

interface.shortDescription: Plan new app and web products from idea to build-ready specs.
interface.longDescription: Vibe Studio bundles a staged product planning workflow for new app and web ideas: brainstorming, benchmark research with competitor screen captures, brand voice, design-system brand fitting, and user-flow generation, then build-spec slices each flow into small, checkable build pieces. Every step writes a markdown source file plus a readable HTML report, and logs user decisions to DECISIONS.md.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a new app or web service with the Vibe Studio workflow.
